data.name: Interactive research demonstration platform
data.research_question: Can research artifacts and findings be presented transparently to supervisors and reviewers?
data.hypothesis: A read-only dashboard with explicit data provenance improves reviewability and methodological transparency.
data.representation: Research artifacts exposed through a versioned read-only API
data.algorithm: React dashboard over FastAPI artifact service

evaluation_configuration.status: Implementation in web/; research validation pending

data.results_summary: Dashboard implementation underway. It does not constitute experimental evidence.
data.interpretation: Supports research communication and traceability, not detection performance.
data.limitations: Not a validated research outcome; no deployment claim.

warnings: Static aggregate snapshot. Event-level provenance is intentionally excluded.
